description: Hardhat 3 plugin that signs transactions, messages and typed data with secp256k1 keys in AWS KMS, Google Cloud KMS, Azure Key Vault or Turnkey.
rules: Install the provider package for your cloud together with the core: hardhat-kms with @hardhat-kms/aws, @hardhat-kms/gcp, @hardhat-kms/azure or @hardhat-kms/turnkey, and list only the provider in plugins.

Credentials never come from the Hardhat config: AWS and Google Cloud use their SDK's credential discovery, Azure uses the plugin's own credential chain, and a Turnkey key reads its API private key from a configuration variable. Never put credentials, private keys or API-keyed RPC URLs in the config.

Run npx hardhat kms accounts to see each key's address, then pin it with the key's address field so a changed key fails loudly, and run npx hardhat kms accounts --check-sign to prove the credentials may sign.
